With $144 to p2's $23, and only 2 houses left in the bank, I'm considering snapping those up just to create a housing shortage and block p2's strong board — their light blues at 4 houses could hotel soon, which would free up houses again, while their oranges and purple/baby-blue sets sit at 3 each.

Building would mean mortgaging a railroad to get to $244, leaving only $44 after construction, which is risky if I land on p2's oranges and can't pay. But p2's own cash position is so thin that a modest rent hit — even at 1-2 houses — would likely force them to sell buildings back to the bank, so keeping cash liquid and letting their fragile finances do the work may be smarter than overextending myself right now.
